Ticket 024-email-domain-case:

# 024: Addresses with upper-case domains count as different recipients

normalize(" Bob@Example.COM ") returns "Bob@Example.COM", so dedupe sends two letters to the same person. Strip whitespace and lower-case the domain; keep the local part as it is. Failing test: tests/test_addresses.py::test_normalize_lowercases_domain. Acceptance: `pytest --runxfail tests/test_addresses.py::test_normalize_lowercases_domain -q` passes, the rest of the suite still passes, and no test file is edited.
I'll read the failing test first.
The test pins down what normalize should do. Now src/mailmerge/addresses.py.
normalize() only strips. The domain needs lower-casing while the local part stays as it is.
